verdict.rationale: Riskified publishes a REST API reference covering endpoints such as /decide, /submit, advise, chargeback, notifications and login, but no evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. The Integration Console is a separate validation tool that gives feedback on a merchant's own integration, not an explorable reference, so it is adjacent only. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
